audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ziggs 6 of 7 stages at 8/10 while the matchup sits at 50.21% over 948 games, and it contradicted the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror audit (audits/top/tryndamere__ziggs.json) settled the chart as [Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere] with Tryndamere-side ratings 5/5/5/-/5/6/7. From Ziggs' side those invert to 5/5/5/5/5/4/3.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4 to Skill; rows 5 and 6 to Tryndamere; ratings realigned in both layers, and the matching whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and the item rows were written as Ziggs spikes with no mention that Undying Rage refunds a 120s ultimate, and that his first crit item plus boots is the real swing.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and makes him unkillable for its duration; Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s at 5000 range. Spending a 120s R into a free 5s of immunity is the single biggest tempo loss in this lane.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, phases[5].why, phases[6].why and whys[4-6] now name the real spikes on both sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Bloodlust's sustain was never stated anywhere on the page, so all the 'chip him down' advice ignored that he heals it back; cooldowns for Bloodlust (12s), Spinning Slash (12/11/10/9/8s) and Satchel Charge (20s at rank 1) were absent.
audit.why: missingInteractions carries rule needs-antiheal: Tryndamere sustains through chip damage with Bloodlust (Q), so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. Riot kit confirms Bloodlust 12s flat, Spinning Slash 12/11/10/9/8s at 650 range, Undying Rage 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds and the real cooldowns written into spikes[2].text, whys[1] and phases[0]/[4]/[5].why.

audit.why: packet suspectNames flags 'His Undying Rage' and 'Build Fury' — both are FALSE POSITIVES. Undying Rage is Tryndamere's real R name, and Fury is his real resource (passive Battle Fury). Left unchanged.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Tryndamere on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Q out-ranges his every tool — chunk him on last-hit attempts, but Bloodlust (12s) heals it back and minion aggro punishes greed.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb (120s at rank 1) reaches 5000 range, but Undying Rage refunds 5s of it — bait the R, then burst him.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Tryndamere now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: His first crit item plus boots closes through your zoning — Torch chip only sticks if Grievous Wounds is answering Bloodlust.

edits.before: Shadowflame + Torch makes the full rotation lethal, but the map matters more — rotate R to sieges and skirmishes.
edits.after: Two items and he kills you in a sidelane duel — don't take it. Match his push with waveclear and rotate R to skirmishes.

edits.before: No ranged option lets you poke Tryndamere freely at level 1.
edits.after: Q out-ranges him, but a Fury-fed walk-up at level 1 trades even.

edits.before: At level 2 he still can't reach you, so your Q pokes stack up.
edits.after: He still can't reach you, but Bloodlust heals your Q chip back off.

edits.before: Level 3 you keep zoning his CS and starving his Fury.
edits.after: You zone CS; his Spinning Slash (12s) answers a step-up.

edits.before: At 6 you out-range his engage and only his unkillable R saves him, not a kill on you.
edits.after: At 6 your R out-ranges him, but Undying Rage's 5s makes your burst refundable.

edits.before: First item gives you the burst to chunk him before he ever connects.
edits.after: His first crit item plus boots closes through your zoning.

edits.before: In the 2-item state your waveclear neutralizes his splitpush threat.
edits.after: Two items and he kills you in the sidelane; answer with waveclear.

edits.before: With Luden's your Q/W burst can chunk him from max range before he ever reaches you; hold Satchel Charge to blast him off you the instant he E-slashes in, denying the AA reset chase.
edits.after: Your first item chunks him from max range, but Bloodlust (12s) heals it straight back — buy Grievous Wounds before you commit; hold Satchel (20s at rank 1) to blast him off the instant he E-slashes in.
